pages.description: [establishing shot of prince calling out to the swallows]
pages.scene: Prince calling out to the swallows

pages.caption: The birds consented, and he said: "Take a thousand greetings from me to the wizard
pages.description: [establishing shot of prince sending greetings to the wizard]
pages.scene: Prince sending greetings to the wizard

pages.caption: of Finland,
pages.description: [close-up detail of prince sending greetings to the wizard]
pages.scene: Prince sending greetings to the wizard

pages.caption: and ask him how I may restore a maiden transformed into a flower to her
pages.description: [characters in prince sending greetings to the wizard]
pages.scene: Prince sending greetings to the wizard

pages.caption: own form."
pages.description: [wide view of prince sending greetings to the wizard]
pages.scene: Prince sending greetings to the wizard

pages.caption: The swallows flew away, and the Prince rode on to the bridge. There he waited,
pages.description: [establishing shot of prince waiting at the bridge in silence]
pages.scene: Prince waiting at the bridge in silence

pages.caption: hoping to hear the song. But he heard nothing but the rushing of the water
pages.description: [close-up detail of prince waiting at the bridge in silence]
pages.scene: Prince waiting at the bridge in silence

pages.caption: and the moaning of the wind, and, disappointed, rode home.
pages.description: [characters in prince waiting at the bridge in silence]
pages.scene: Prince waiting at the bridge in silence

pages.caption: Shortly after, he was sitting in the garden, thinking that the swallows must have forgotten
pages.description: [establishing shot of prince in the garden, watching an eagle]
pages.scene: Prince in the garden, watching an eagle

pages.caption: his message,
pages.description: [close-up detail of prince in the garden, watching an eagle]
pages.scene: Prince in the garden, watching an eagle

pages.caption: when he saw an eagle flying above him.
pages.description: [characters in prince in the garden, watching an eagle]
pages.scene: Prince in the garden, watching an eagle

pages.caption: The bird gradually descended until it perched on a tree close to the Prince.
pages.description: [establishing shot of eagle descending to perch near the prince]
pages.scene: Eagle descending to perch near the prince

pages.caption: And said: "The wizard of Finland greets thee and bids me say that thou mayest
pages.description: [establishing shot of eagle delivering the wizard's instructions]

pages.caption: free the maiden thus: Go to the river and smear thyself all over with mud."
pages.description: [close-up detail of eagle delivering the wizard's instructions]

pages.caption: "Then say: 'From a man into a crab,' and thou wilt become a crab."
pages.description: [establishing shot of eagle explaining the transformation]

pages.caption: "Plunge boldly into the water, swim as close as thou canst to the water-lily's roots,
pages.description: [establishing shot of crab swimming toward water-lily roots]

pages.caption: and loosen them from the mud and reeds."
pages.description: [close-up detail of crab swimming toward water-lily roots]

pages.caption: "This done, fasten thy claws into the roots and rise with them to the surface.
pages.description: [establishing shot of crab carrying the water-lily to the surface]
pages.scene: Crab carrying the water-lily to the surface

pages.caption: Let the water flow all over the flower."
pages.description: [close-up detail of crab carrying the water-lily to the surface]
pages.scene: Crab carrying the water-lily to the surface

pages.caption: "And drift with the current until thou comest to a mountain ash tree on the
pages.description: [establishing shot of crab drifting toward the mountain ash tree]
pages.scene: Crab drifting toward the mountain ash tree

pages.caption: left bank.
pages.description: [close-up detail of crab drifting toward the mountain ash tree]
pages.scene: Crab drifting toward the mountain ash tree

pages.caption: There is near it a large stone."
pages.description: [characters in crab drifting toward the mountain ash tree]
pages.scene: Crab drifting toward the mountain ash tree

pages.caption: "Stop there and say: 'From a crab into a man, from a water-lily into a
pages.description: [establishing shot of eagle completing the instructions]

pages.caption: maiden,' and ye both will be restored to your own forms."
pages.description: [close-up detail of eagle completing the instructions]

pages.caption: Full of doubt and fear, the Prince let some time pass before he was bold
pages.description: [establishing shot of prince hesitating with doubt]

pages.caption: enough to attempt to rescue the maiden.
pages.description: [close-up detail of prince hesitating with doubt]

pages.caption: Then a crow said to him: "Why dost thou hesitate? The old wizard has not
pages.description: [establishing shot of crow urging the prince to act]
pages.scene: Crow urging the prince to act

pages.caption: told thee wrong, neither have the birds deceived thee; hasten and dry the maiden's tears."
pages.description: [close-up detail of crow urging the prince to act]
pages.scene: Crow urging the prince to act

pages.caption: "Nothing worse than death can befall me," thought the Prince, "and death is better than
pages.description: [establishing shot of prince resolving to face death]

pages.caption: endless sorrow."
pages.description: [close-up detail of prince resolving to face death]

pages.caption: So he mounted his horse and went to the bridge. Again he heard the water-lily's
pages.description: [establishing shot of prince riding to the bridge determined]
pages.scene: Prince riding to the bridge determined

pages.caption: lament,
pages.description: [close-up detail of prince riding to the bridge determined]
pages.scene: Prince riding to the bridge determined

pages.caption: and, hesitating no longer.
pages.description: [characters in prince riding to the bridge determined]
pages.scene: Prince riding to the bridge determined

pages.caption: Smeared himself all over with mud, and, saying: "From a man into a crab," plunged
pages.description: [establishing shot of prince smearing himself with mud]

pages.caption: into the river.
pages.description: [close-up detail of prince smearing himself with mud]

pages.caption: For one moment the water hissed in his ears, and then all was silent.
pages.description: [establishing shot of prince transformed into a crab]

pages.caption: He swam up to the plant and began to loosen its roots, but so firmly
pages.description: [establishing shot of crab loosening the water-lily roots]

pages.caption: were they fixed in the mud and reeds that this took him a long time.
pages.description: [close-up detail of crab loosening the water-lily roots]

pages.caption: He then grasped them and rose to the surface, letting the water flow over the
pages.description: [establishing shot of crab rising to the surface with the flower]
pages.scene: Crab rising to the surface with the flower

pages.caption: flower.
pages.description: [close-up detail of crab rising to the surface with the flower]
pages.scene: Crab rising to the surface with the flower

pages.caption: The current carried them down the stream, but nowhere could he see the mountain ash.
pages.description: [establishing shot of crab drifting with the current]

pages.caption: At last he saw it, and close by the large stone.
pages.description: [establishing shot of crab reaching the mountain ash and stone]
pages.scene: Crab reaching the mountain ash and stone

pages.caption: Here he stopped and said: "From a crab into a man, from a water-lily into
pages.description: [establishing shot of prince restored, maiden by his side]
pages.scene: Prince restored, maiden by his side

pages.caption: a maiden," and to his delight found himself once more a prince, and the maiden
pages.description: [close-up detail of prince restored, maiden by his side]
pages.scene: Prince restored, maiden by his side

pages.caption: was by his side.
pages.description: [characters in prince restored, maiden by his side]
pages.scene: Prince restored, maiden by his side

pages.caption: She was ten times more beautiful than before, and wore a magnificent pale yellow robe,
pages.description: [establishing shot of maiden in a yellow robe sparkling with jewels]
pages.scene: Maiden in a yellow robe sparkling with jewels

pages.caption: sparkling with jewels.
pages.description: [close-up detail of maiden in a yellow robe sparkling with jewels]
pages.scene: Maiden in a yellow robe sparkling with jewels

pages.caption: She thanked him for having freed her from the cruel witch's power, and willingly consented
pages.description: [establishing shot of maiden thanking the prince]

pages.caption: to marry him.
pages.description: [close-up detail of maiden thanking the prince]

pages.caption: But when they came to the bridge where he had left his horse it was
pages.description: [establishing shot of the couple finding no horse at the bridge]
pages.scene: The couple finding no horse at the bridge

pages.caption: nowhere to be seen, for, though the Prince thought he had been a crab only
pages.description: [close-up detail of the couple finding no horse at the bridge]
pages.scene: The couple finding no horse at the bridge

pages.caption: a few hours, he had in reality been under the water for more than ten
pages.description: [characters in the couple finding no horse at the bridge]
pages.scene: The couple finding no horse at the bridge

pages.caption: days.
pages.description: [wide view of the couple finding no horse at the bridge]
pages.scene: The couple finding no horse at the bridge

pages.caption: While they were wondering how they should reach his father's court, they saw a splendid
pages.description: [establishing shot of couple wondering how to reach the court]
pages.scene: Couple wondering how to reach the court

pages.caption: coach driven by six gaily caparisoned horses coming along the bank.
pages.description: [close-up detail of couple wondering how to reach the court]
pages.scene: Couple wondering how to reach the court

pages.caption: In this they drove to the palace.
pages.description: [establishing shot of riding in the splendid coach]

pages.caption: The King and Queen were at church, weeping for their son, whom they had long
pages.description: [establishing shot of king and queen weeping in church]
pages.scene: King and Queen weeping in church

pages.caption: mourned for dead.
pages.description: [close-up detail of king and queen weeping in church]
pages.scene: King and Queen weeping in church

pages.caption: Great was their delight and astonishment when the Prince entered, leading the beautiful maiden by
pages.description: [establishing shot of prince and maiden entering the palace]
pages.scene: Prince and maiden entering the palace

pages.caption: the hand.
pages.description: [close-up detail of prince and maiden entering the palace]
pages.scene: Prince and maiden entering the palace

pages.caption: The wedding was at once celebrated and there was feasting and merry-making throughout the kingdom
pages.description: [establishing shot of wedding celebration with feasting]

pages.caption: for six weeks.
pages.description: [close-up detail of wedding celebration with feasting]

pages.caption: Some time afterward the Prince and his bride were sitting in the garden.
pages.description: [establishing shot of couple sitting in the garden]

pages.caption: When a crow said to them: "Ungrateful creatures! Have you forgotten the two poor maidens
pages.description: [establishing shot of crow reminding them of their promise]
pages.scene: Crow reminding them of their promise

pages.caption: who helped you in your distress?"
pages.description: [close-up detail of crow reminding them of their promise]
pages.scene: Crow reminding them of their promise

pages.caption: "Must they spin gold flax for ever? Have no pity on the old witch."
pages.description: [establishing shot of crow scolding the prince]

pages.caption: "The three maidens are princesses, whom she stole away when they were children together, with
pages.description: [establishing shot of crow revealing the maidens are princesses]
pages.scene: Crow revealing the maidens are princesses

pages.caption: all the silver utensils, which she turned into gold flax."
pages.description: [close-up detail of crow revealing the maidens are princesses]
pages.scene: Crow revealing the maidens are princesses

pages.caption: "Poison were her fittest punishment."
pages.description: [establishing shot of crow suggesting punishment]

pages.caption: The Prince was ashamed of having forgotten his promise and set out at once.
pages.description: [establishing shot of prince ashamed of forgetting]

pages.caption: And by great good fortune reached the hut when the old woman was away.
pages.description: [establishing shot of prince reaching the hut while the witch is away]
pages.scene: Prince reaching the hut while the witch is away

pages.caption: The maidens had dreamed that he was coming, and were ready to go with him.
pages.description: [establishing shot of maidens ready to depart]

pages.caption: But first they made a cake in which they put poison, and left it on
pages.description: [establishing shot of sisters baking a poisoned cake]

pages.caption: a table where the old woman was likely to see it when she returned.
pages.description: [close-up detail of sisters baking a poisoned cake]

pages.caption: She did see it, and thought it looked so tempting that she greedily ate it
pages.description: [establishing shot of witch eating the poisoned cake]

pages.caption: up and at once died.
pages.description: [close-up detail of witch eating the poisoned cake]

pages.caption: In the secret chamber were found fifty wagon-loads of gold flax, and as much more
pages.description: [establishing shot of fifty wagon-loads of gold flax discovered]
pages.scene: Fifty wagon-loads of gold flax discovered

pages.caption: was discovered buried.
pages.description: [close-up detail of fifty wagon-loads of gold flax discovered]
pages.scene: Fifty wagon-loads of gold flax discovered

pages.caption: The hut was razed to the ground.
pages.description: [establishing shot of hut razed to the ground]

pages.caption: And the Prince and his bride and her two sisters lived happily ever after.
pages.description: [close-up detail of happily ever after]
